cards.name: Prinny Squad
cards.text:
【CONT】 You can put any number of cards with the same card name as this card into your deck.

【ACT】 [Put a 《Prinny》 character into your waiting room] Choose one of your opponent's characters in the center stage, and that character gets -1000 power until end of turn.

cards.name: Fallen Angel of Love. Flonne
cards.text: 【AUTO】 [Put this card into your waiting room] When a card named "Netherworld Wrapped in Love" is placed on your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "“Pinch Revival” Pure Flonne" in your waiting room, and put it on this card's previous stage position.

cards.name: “Pinch Revival” Pure Flonne
cards.text:
【CONT】 If there is a marker underneath this card, this card gets +1500 power.

【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your waiting room, you may choose an 《Angel》 character in your waiting room, and put it face down underneath this card as a marker.

【AUTO】 Encore [Put the top card of your deck into your clock] (When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】)

cards.name: Raspberyl & Sapphire All Ready for Gym
cards.text: 【CONT】 If the number of climax in your waiting room is four or more, this card gets "【AUTO】 Encore ［Put a character from your hand into your waiting room］".

cards.name: Netherworld Wrapped in Love
cards.text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from your hand, draw a card, choose one of your characters, and that character gets +2000 power and +1 soul until end of turn.

cards.name: Overlord's Vassal, Etna
cards.text:
【AUTO】 [(1)] When this card attacks, if a card named "Overlord Zenon Defeated!!" is in your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, search your deck for up to one 《Prinny》 character, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.

【ACT】 [(1)] Choose one of your 《Prinny》 characters, and that character gets the following ability until end of turn. "【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】, if the level of this card's battle opponent is lower than or equal to the level of this card, you may 【REVERSE】 that character."

cards.name: Aesthetics of Evil, Valvatorez
cards.text: 【ACT】 Brainstorm [(1)] Reveal four cards from the top of your deck, and put them into your waiting room. For each climax revealed, choose one of your 《Demon》 characters, and that character gets +2000 power until end of turn.

cards.name: Son of the Previous Overlord, Laharl
cards.text:
【CONT】 All of your other characters get the following ability. "【CONT】 This card cannot side attack."

【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, draw up to two cards, choose a card in you hand, and put it into your waiting room.

【AUTO】 [(1)] During your turn, when another of your characters becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, if this card is on your center stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, 【REST】 that character.

cards.name: Reborn Krichevskoy
cards.text:
【CONT】 You can put any number of cards with the same card name as this card into your deck.

【AUTO】 When this card attacks, choose one of your other characters, and that character gets +1500 power until end of turn.

cards.name: Girl Laharl
cards.text: 【AUTO】 [(1) Put a card named "Eternal Idol" from your hand into your waiting room] When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "Idol Overlord, Girl Laharl" in your waiting room, and put it on any position of your stage as 【REST】.

cards.name: Proud Demon, Valvatorez
cards.text: 【ACT】  Backup 3000, Level 2 [(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose one of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +3000 power until end of turn)

cards.name: Mecha-Jennifer
cards.text: Deal X damage to your opponent. X is equal to the number of climax in your waiting room. (This damage may be canceled)

cards.name: Ties of "Camaraderie"
cards.text:
【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.


(: When this card triggers, you may choose a character from your waiting room, and return it to your hand.)

cards.name: Eternal Idol
cards.text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from your hand, choose up to one red card in your waiting room, put it into your stock, and all of your characters get +1 soul until end of turn.

cards.name: Overlord Zenon Defeated!!
cards.text:
